description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Permanently delete a saved preset or meal. Deleting a preset also removes it from every meal that used it. Timers already on the board are unaffected. Run history is cleared with clear_history.

item.description: Id or name of the preset or meal. Case-insensitive; an ambiguous name is an error listing the candidates with their ids.

kind.description: Which library item to delete. Presets are single reusable timers; meals are named groups of dishes; a recipe is a meal with steps (only while recipes are switched on for the phone).

name: delete_saved

delivery.description: How recently the phone checked in, so you never imply it has seen this.

lastSyncAgo.description: Last sync in words, e.g. '2m ago'.

notified.description: A push about this change went out.

removedFromMeals.description: Meals scrubbed of a deleted preset.

runningTimersUnaffected.description: Timers still on the board; deleting a saved item never touches them.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: Delete a saved preset or meal
